label: Accept referral and begin assessment
description: Confirms the referred matter is within enforcement scope.

label: Withdraw case
description: Declines or withdraws the matter from enforcement.

label: Record assessment findings
description: Records the enforcement assessment of the referred matter.

label: Issue enforcement notice
description: Issues the formal notice. Requires assessment findings and a notice reference.

label: Withdraw case
description: Closes the matter without enforcement action.

label: Record representation received
description: Records a representation received from the entity.

label: Complete evidence review
description: Closes the representation window and refers the case to the decision maker.

label: Record further representation
description: Records a further representation received from the entity.

label: Complete evidence review
description: Confirms the evidence and representations are complete.

label: Make enforcement decision
description: Records the final enforcement decision, its legal basis and rationale.

label: Decide no enforcement action
description: Concludes that no enforcement action is warranted.

label: Impose sanction
description: Imposes the sanction, including any monetary penalty.

label: Issue directive
description: Issues a remedial directive to the entity.

label: Lodge appeal
description: Records an appeal lodged against the enforcement decision.

label: Record obligation
description: Adds a compliance obligation to be monitored.

label: Review remediation
description: Records the outcome of a remediation review.

label: Record penalty payment
description: Records a payment or governed waiver against the monetary penalty.

label: Lodge appeal
description: Records an appeal lodged against the enforcement decision.

label: Close case
description: Closes the case once mandatory obligations are discharged.

label: Decide appeal
description: Records the appeal outcome and its effect. The original decision is preserved.
